evidence.quote: The charity-run arts venue and cinema in Shoreditch
Rich Mix will remain open for gigs and festivals.

findings.value: Gigs and festivals in its main room, The Stage. Club and grime nights open with a screening and talk in the cinema, then a gig. Autumn 2026 listings include a K-music festival, a West African music gig and a 'London, From the Margins' season of music and talks. The cinema is paused until autumn 2027.

evidence.quote: The gig will take place in The Stage.
Soulful vocals, shimmering kora melodies and complex rhythmic Malian guitar in
a special programme of music, talks and occasional film screenings
our recently announced London, From the Margins season

not_found: music.styles: no genre named on more than one night; the venue's own pages name genres only on single events
cost.notes: only per-event prices on DICE, no general pricing stated
richmix.org.uk: returned 403, not read or fetched
notes: Upcoming nights on DICE (venue page, read 2026-10-13): K-MUSIC FESTIVAL: CHUDAHYE CHAGIS, Sat 17 Oct 2026, 7:30pm (gig, described as psychedelic shamanic funk); Manding Melody featuring Habib Koite & Sura Susso, Sun 1 Nov 2026, 7pm; Brick by Brick: Grime, Sat 14 Nov 2026, screening and talk 6:30pm then gig; After Dark: Club, Sat 28 Nov 2026, screening and talk then gig. Time Out (17 Sep 2026) says the cinema is paused for 12 months and the building stays open for live events; that is for the reviews researcher to weigh as status.
